name: SMS
tagline: A Zenvia SMS gateway that keeps every text, walks it through delivery steps and lets the person text back.
point: X-API-TOKEN: any value (any_token is on by default)
MESSAGE_STATUS and MESSAGE go to the URLs in sms/service.yaml

capabilities.title: See every text
capabilities.text: Every send, refusal and reply, newest first, with its encoding (GSM-7 or UCS-2), segment count and the code found in it.

capabilities.title: Delivery steps per number
capabilities.text: Recipients decide what happens: delivered after 3 s, not delivered with a reason, never delivered, or a reply after a delay.

capabilities.title: The person texts back
capabilities.text: reply_sms_as_user sends Zenvia's MESSAGE webhook to the app. STOP-like words opt the number out; START opts it back in.

capabilities.title: Opt-outs enforced
capabilities.text: A send to an opted-out number gets 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, as Zenvia answers. Add or remove numbers by hand too.

capabilities.title: Status callbacks on demand
capabilities.text: Move a text to SENT, DELIVERED or NOT_DELIVERED with a reason, or send the same callback again to test duplicates.

capabilities.title: Callbacks with your answers
capabilities.text: Every MESSAGE_STATUS and MESSAGE callback is kept with the status your app returned; retry the ones it did not take.

capabilities.title: Limits like the gateway
capabilities.text: Over the throughput limit gets 429; over max segments gets 400 "message too long". Strict senders and templates refuse unknown ids.

capabilities.title: Wait for the code
capabilities.text: wait_for_sms blocks until the app texts a number and returns the OTP it found, so a sign-in test needs no phone.

excerpts.title: Every text, with what the app saw

callouts.title: Opted out
callouts.text: The person texted STOP; the next send to this number is refused 400, as Zenvia does.

callouts.title: Code extracted
callouts.text: The OTP is pulled out of the text; wait_for_sms returns it to the test.

callouts.title: Encoding and segments
callouts.text: GSM-7 or UCS-2, characters per segment and the segment count billing would use.

callouts.title: Status, as the app saw it
callouts.text: Accepted, SENT, DELIVERED: each callback with the status your app answered.

callouts.title: Provoke on this message
callouts.text: Not delivered with a reason, or the same DELIVERED callback again.

callouts.title: Pattern match
callouts.text: A number pattern with a trailing *: phone off, the text expires after 48 h.

callouts.title: Delivered after
callouts.text: Each text is delivered after the wait you set, and the status callback follows.

callouts.title: Answer a question
callouts.text: When the text asks something, the person replies with this text after 30 s.

callouts.title: Nth text
callouts.text: On the third text in a day the person replies STOP and opts out.

callouts.title: Saved as YAML
callouts.text: Recipients live in sms/recipients.yaml; first match wins, * is everyone else.

callouts.title: Senders
callouts.text: Alphanumeric, short code and long number; with strict_senders an unknown from gets 400.

callouts.title: Callbacks to the app
callouts.text: Where MESSAGE_STATUS and MESSAGE (replies) are posted.

callouts.title: Opt-out keywords
callouts.text: STOP, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE opt out; START opts back in. Numbers on the list are shown.

callouts.title: Throughput
callouts.text: Messages a second before the gateway answers 429.

callouts.title: Body size
callouts.text: More segments than this gets 400 "message too long".

provoke.name: 500 on the next send
provoke.what: Zenvia's INTERNAL_ERROR body; count sets how many sends fail

provoke.name: 400 validation error
provoke.what: A VALIDATION_ERROR body, as Zenvia sends for bad input

provoke.name: Broken connection
provoke.what: The connection resets, answers nothing, or hangs

provoke.name: Not delivered
provoke.what: invalid, carrier_rejected, phone_off, blocked or not_covered

provoke.name: Never delivered
provoke.what: The text stays SENT and expires after 48 h

provoke.name: The person texts STOP
provoke.what: The number opts out; the next send is refused 400

provoke.name: Rate limit
provoke.what: Sends over the messages-a-second limit get 429

advantages.title: No real phone needed
advantages.text: Codes, replies and STOPs happen on the screen or from a tool; nobody waits for a handset or pays for a text.

advantages.title: Failures on the next call
advantages.text: 500, timeout or a carrier refusal comes exactly when the test asks, then stops by itself.

advantages.title: Callbacks you can replay
advantages.text: Resend or retry any status callback and see what your app answered, which a real gateway never shows.

advantages.title: Behaviour per number
advantages.text: Each number has its own steps: one delivers, one is switched off, one answers yes in 30 s.

agent.prompt: Check that our app stops texting a customer after they reply STOP.
steps: MESSAGE webhook sent, acme-api answered 200; number opted out
next reminder refused 400 VALIDATION_ERROR: opted out (texted STOP)
tools: Every text both ways, with status history and the code found
Wait for the app to text a number; returns the OTP
The person texts back; STOP opts out
Move a text to SENT, DELIVERED or NOT_DELIVERED
Send the same status callback again
The next sends fail: 500, 400, reset, empty, timeout
Steps for a number: delays, refusals, replies
Callbacks sent to the app, with its answers

notes: Port 8025 serves SMS together with the screen, /api and /mcp.
Settings live in sms/service.yaml and sms/recipients.yaml per environment.
